proof_script:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
umask 077
test "$(id -u)" = 0
test "$(id -ru)" = 0
test "$(id -g)" = 0
boot=$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)
case "$boot" in *[!a-f0-9-]*|'') exit 80;; esac
proofdir=/home/owner/share/tmp/sdk_tools/aerotizen-probe-proof-22222222222222222222222222222222
test ! -e "$proofdir"
test ! -L "$proofdir"
mkdir -m 755 "$proofdir"
chsmack -a _ "$proofdir"
cd "$proofdir"
proof=proof.json
test ! -e "$proof.new"
test ! -L "$proof.new"
set -C
printf '{"schema_version":1,"uid":0,"euid":0,"gid":0,"boot_id":"%s","nonce":"22222222222222222222222222222222","payload_sha256":"5f647158f4c4fd502f1481c2692a95663516e934d11a13b45d5cd821d85d9671"}\n' "$boot" > "$proof.new"
set +C
chmod 444 "$proof.new"
chsmack -a _ "$proof.new"
mv -f "$proof.new" "$proof"
